business_overview.one_sentence: BOE Varitronix is principally engaged in automotive and industrial display business, with monochrome display manufacturing capacity and TFT/touch panel display module assembly capacity.

segments.name: Automotive display
segments.source: Annual Report 2023, business review / five year segment revenue table

segments.name: Industrial display
segments.source: Annual Report 2023, business review / segment disclosure

business_overview.revenue_model: Sale of LCD, TFT and touch panel display modules; revenue recognised when customers take possession and accept products.
business_notes: The Company is a subsidiary of BOE Technology Group Co., Ltd.; immediate parent is BOE Technology (HK) Limited.
Five largest customers accounted for 48.4% of 2023 revenue and the largest customer accounted for 21.2%.
Trade debtors and bills receivable are generally due within 60 to 90 days from billing.

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: 2023 operating cash flow covered accounting profit, but three-year free cash flow is volatile because 2022 expansion capex was heavy; 2023 inventories and receivables also increased with production capacity and sales scale. Use a numerical haircut on distributable cash profit.

gaps: Annual report does not split group cash by legal entity/parent dividend accessibility beyond Mainland China location disclosure.
Annual report does not explicitly separate maintenance capex from growth capex; capex haircut uses total capex history and operating evidence.
Cost of sales/gross profit are not separately presented in the extracted consolidated statement; manufacturing input lines are available instead.
